d: Pale blonde, very long hair flows past the hips with straight textures and blunt-cut bangs. The eyes are a sharp ruby red with a focused, serious expression on a youthful, adolescent face. The build is slender and petite, dressed in a blue and gold military-style outfit featuring a short pleated skirt, a high-collared bodice, white stockings, and a small blue pillbox hat. A large, ornate golden staff with a glowing red orb is held in one hand, complemented by gold star-shaped ornaments on the boots.
